For me the most interesting idea for a product like this is that it has to be able to do anything our smartphones, laptops and tablets do. It has to be good for watching content everywhere in the house like a tablet, be easily connected to socials and be good in communication like smartphones, be powerful and specific as laptops/pcs, and it has to manage to do all of this in one solution. The way it's presented sounds very promising, especially because they're not advertising it as a tool for some niche things like the meta verse was, this is something you should use to do what you already do, just better. More immersive content, more intuitive controls, more connected to the outside world, more practical since the screen is always on you and you don't have to take it out of your pocket or turn it on from standby etc. If they manage to quickly nail down the software this needs to operate this way, it could be basically a perfect substitute to most digital devices we have at home. And I want to stress how this appeals to me as a home device, I wouldn't want to go around with this thing attached to my face, where I need to spend some time taking it on and off depending on what I'm doing. What I imagine doing is coming back home from work, getting this on my head and just doing what I would have normally done on my tv/pc/smartphone/tablet. The extra function for 3d photos is great, but we don't really need to replace that with the quick picture taken with your phone of some notes taken on the spot, something you wanted to show your friends or stuff like that. It's good to have specialized media functions - the latest iphones already are that, you don't neet that powerful of a camera for everyday use - but having the option is more than good, even though I guess it assumes other people need one of these devices as well to make use of the special 3d photos. Overall, I think it's going to be interesting to see how this plays out, and knowing it's apple, I'm sure they have thought of most of this before hand as to not make this a total flop.
